name: POST /api/leadflow/capture/quick - Capture a lead in one call
description:
The one-call capture path behind the Quick Capture surface. Accepts what an operator actually has in front of them — raw text or an image, optionally a parsed proposal they have already reviewed — and orchestrates the SDKs that own each part: sdk-media to commit an uploaded image, sdk-parsing to extract contact fields when the client ASKED for assistance, sdk-source-record to store the raw input as immutable evidence under the declared origin class, and sdk-identity-resolver only when searchAfterCapture is true. A create at a collection root, so it answers 201.

ORIGIN CLASS IS MANDATORY AND IS NEVER GUESSED. Omitting it answers 422, not 400 and not a defaulted value: the payload is syntactically fine, so the request is well-formed but cannot be processed. Origin class is what the whole trust ladder rests on — it is the difference between a record a person handed us and one scraped from somewhere — and a default would silently promote unknown provenance into trusted data. Quarantine is the only honest answer to unknown origin.

RESOLUTION NEVER AUTO-LINKS AN AMBIGUOUS MATCH. An exact crosswalk hit links automatically because it is not a judgement; anything short of that creates a P2_CANDIDATE for a human to adjudicate. Auto-linking a probable match is how two different people become one record, and that merge is far harder to undo than it was to make.

PARSING IS ASSISTIVE, NEVER AUTHORITATIVE. It runs only when the caller sets mode to 'assisted', and its output is a PROPOSAL the operator has already seen. The stored evidence is always the raw input, never the parse — so a wrong extraction can be corrected later against what actually arrived.

Every successful capture appends capture.created to the audit chain, naming the acting persona and the origin class. Protected by the authenticate guard.

QA: depends on register and login for a bearer token. The SDK calls degrade locally when no gateway is configured, so the endpoint answers 201 either way and the assertions here hold in both states.

testCases.name: Capture raw text with a declared origin class

payload.rawInput: Priya Raman, priya@example.com, 07700 900123 - roof leak over the kitchen

testCases.name: Raw input is echoed back verbatim, not the parsed interpretation
Reject a capture with no origin class - 422, never a default
Reject an origin class outside the vocabulary
Reject a capture with no raw input - there is no evidence to store
Resolution requested: an ambiguous match stays a candidate, unlinked

errorCases.message: rawInput is required; mode, visibility and relationshipHint must be within their vocabularies
errorCases.when: rawInput is missing or blank, or an enum field carries a value outside its list
the Authorization header is absent or the token does not verify

errorCases.message: originClass is required and must be one of the declared origin classes
errorCases.when: originClass is absent, blank, or outside the vocabulary. Distinct from VALIDATION_ERROR on purpose: the request is well-formed, and the refusal is a policy about provenance rather than a syntax complaint. A client that retries with a guessed value must be told it is still wrong.

errorCases.message: A ProjexCloud SDK required by this capture is unavailable
errorCases.when: a configured gateway fails. NOT raised when the gateway is unconfigured — that is the documented local fallback and still answers 201.
